claim: T describes matched LPRD in the frozen selected cohort. The stratified cluster resampling measures T's sensitivity to reweighting the observed games. Its central 95% interval is an empirical stability interval, not an established confidence interval for repeated L0 designs. GO means enough effect and stability to justify ONE confirmation run, not proof of a population effect.
meaning: GO = sufficient effect and resampling stability to justify ONE confirmation run; not proof of a population effect
